section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the present study for Gratitude, Loneliness, and Social Support. Gratitude was assessed using the 6-item Gratitude Questionnaire-6 (GQ-6), Loneliness with the 20-item UCLA Loneliness Scale (version 3), and Social Support with the 10-item Social Support Rating Scale, which includes three subscales. The psychometric properties of the scales were noted as validated in a Chinese population, and some items for social support were revised for college students in the present study, with Cronbach's alpha values of .85, .77, and .71 reported for Gratitude, Loneliness, and Social Support, respectively.
